shared_elements: schematic human figure with splayed/outstretched limbs
pecked linear silhouette figures on an open rock surface
stick-like limbs rendered as simple strokes
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic, stick-limbed anthropomorphic figures reduced to simple pecked strokes with splayed arms and legs, a genuine convention-level match in how a human body is rendered. But A is a crowded composition dominated by long crewed boats with rows of vertical crew strokes, plus footprints and grouped small figures, whereas B shows only one isolated large figure with no boat, no companions and no compositional grouping, so relationships and arrangement scarcely correspond.
